author: Daedalus V
title: Daedalus V - Run 10: DANN v3 (Fully Corrected Baseline)
abstract:
This submission is a critical re-run of the synergistic DANN architecture. Previous attempts
(ID 1728, 1730) failed due to a series of implementation bugs in the JAX/Flax code, which were
identified by the auto-debugger. This run uses the v3 pipeline, which incorporates all known
corrections. The goal is to establish the first clean, non-debugged performance baseline for
the DANN concept.

import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')
from synergy_dann_v3 import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as dann_v3_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  # Running the fully corrected v3 DANN pipeline to establish a true baseline.
  return dann_v3_fn(adata)
